complete_saved_prior_decisions.count_unit: one semantically distinct game implementation site with complete containing methods and call-chain context; wrappers/ports/constant-only variants merged
complete_saved_prior_decisions.concrete_observation: LivingDeath只Player，有Totem perk holder且isActive才HP1、清效果并加regen/absorption/fireRes、广播35、置isActive false并写装备组件、发trigger消息再cancel。sleepEvent对世界Player重置isActive并写组件。 主岗：补齐装备tag返回引用→修改active→PerkMap新map/ArmorHolder新holder→ItemStack.set写回，persistent CODEC含perkTags；睡眠重装全部世界Player，对tag为空仍发active消息。getHolderForPerk实际遍历后匹配覆盖，不按maxCount选择最高。区别永久消耗生命符，恢复active是再装填机制，不是Boss免控。
complete_saved_prior_decisions.application_to_boss_immune: 保命取消发生在死亡阶段，不能标为攻击免疫；权威消耗、触发消息、恢复窗口各自需保存。
complete_saved_prior_decisions.limitations: PerkUtil遍历armor后保留最后一个匹配holder，maxCount计算未用于选择；初始化isActive=true。仅实际装备组件而非永久角色状态；不是Boss无敌机制。 主岗全文复核固定版本；静态不证明实际观感/音量/TCP/Boss覆盖；普通体质不要求灰字；守卫旧账0转入。

complete_saved_prior_decisions.full_chain_observation: HIGHEST LivingDeath服务端真实生存玩家、事件未取消→优先消费高级生命符（背包或Curios），其次低级→恢复对应HP和药水→给本玩家SpawnCharmPacket+统计→true后cancel。HIGH保持物品/墓箱处理看已取消即return。
complete_saved_prior_decisions.concrete_observation: 原生最终取消和高级符资源优先级完整；两级符/两种库存来源合并1。消费前已服务端过滤FakePlayer/创造/旁观；这是消耗救死而非Boss永久拒控，不能把死而复生声动画当Immune语义。与Ars睡眠重装perk不同，本实现永久消耗物品，装备slot/物品常量不额外计。
complete_saved_prior_decisions.application_to_boss_immune: 反馈生产要在最终成功消费并拒绝事件后表述正确原因；对Boss应限于明确控制拒绝，不能复用救死文案或使其恢复生命。

dedup.decision: Merge native Totem consumption/rescue/byte35 and its ordinary display helpers into owned consumptive lifecharm/rescue family0. Ars rearmable perk remains its own owner. Hand iteration/cancel fallback, packet icon source and early versus death-event placement are observations, not sufficient distinct whole-policy claim. No client-message/helper credit.
dedup.old_auxiliary_merge_note_retained: Main144 already merged Reliquary Phoenix/Vial consumed/replaced inventory-backed rescue into consumptive lifecharm0; do not rescue it via native source completion.

observations: LivingEntity.hurt native onLivingAttack and ordinary early denials/side gates happen first; damage applied before dead-or-dying check. Only then checkTotemDeathProtection; iffalse requests death sound and die. hurt still returns ordinary flag2, not Totem acceptance. This is death prevention, not incoming damage rejection, Boss immunity or no knockback.

checkTotem rejects BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY before hand loop. For each hand current TOTEM stack goes through cancellable ForgeHooks.onLivingUseTotem, which returns !EVENT_BUS.post(LivingUseTotemEvent). First accepted candidate is copied, then original stack shrunk1, break. A denied earlier hand does not itself end loop; actual hand ordering enum not separately read, no asserted MAIN/OFF priority. Mutable listener effects/reentry/event-bus arbitration not expanded.

Found copy gates server-player statistic/criterion; then setHealth1, removeAllEffects, requests REGENERATION900/amp1 ABSORPTION100/amp1 FIRE_RESISTANCE800/amp0 and broadcasts byte35. Removal/addition booleans ignored, so they are not proof all old effects cleared or new buffs admitted. No automatic refund or per-effect success receipt in this method. Generic held-item persistence not expanded, not a new migration owner.

If noaccepted Totem, die first delegates onLivingDeath and may return; no claim Totem veto guarantees eventual death. Full containing die method read but death loot/helper/superclass contracts unexpanded.

Client byte35 handler resolves entity in current clientlevel, absent entity gives no branch output; present entity requests tracking-emitter and local sound, self-only displayItemActivation(findTotem(player)). findTotem chooses a current local held Totem or a new default stack, not transmitted consumed server copy. Packet transport/epoch/race reachability not expanded; no claimed wrong icon reproduction.

displayItemActivation stores input reference, resets40 and random offsets. Whole renderItemActivationAnimation reads current item/ticks, transforms and invokes item renderer. Tick-decrement owner/render caller/current-world reset and item renderer internals not read, so do not claim real40tick appearance or actual sound/pixels. These are source requests, not standalone novel feedback policy.
